actions.findings: Current automated agentic frameworks prioritize hypothesis validation and normative auditing over the instantiation of persistent selfhood. [source-0c3114b8bfe140df] [source-f26a645e047847a2]
actions.limitations: The available literature addresses the normative and operational requirements of decision-making systems rather than the structural prerequisites for personal identity or continuous selfhood. actions.next_questions: What specific architectural components (e.g., recursive self-modeling, integration of temporal causality) are required to bridge the gap between static episodic storage and persistent identity?
